The UK EQUATOR Centre is run by Professor Gary Collins and has members at the University of Birmingham and the University of Oxford. The UK Centre is the head office of the EQUATOR Network. The Centre works with partner organisations and initiatives and contributes to the work of the EQUATOR Network as a whole. 

The UK EQUATOR Centre's work includes:

* Development and maintenance of the EQUATOR Network website and resources.
* Maintaining the world's only comprehensive database of reporting guidelines.
* [Education and training](../training.qmd). Organising workshops, courses, seminars, conferences for researchers, research students, editors and peer reviewers.
* Collaborative activities to raise reporting standards.
* Developing new reporting guidelines.
* Implementation research to increase adherence to reporting guidelines.
